Every guide on this site is written and checked by our Australian-Thai team, which has run island trips on Koh Samui and Koh Phangan since 2006. We check facts against primary sources, review prices and dates on booking pages every month and event dates every week, show an "Updated" date on every page, and correct confirmed errors as soon as we can. We take no paid placements, publish no fake reviews and never link to other tour operators or booking sites.

Who writes our guides

Our guides are written by the same team that sells and runs the trips: people who handle pickups, talk to boat crews about the sea every evening and answer guests' questions on WhatsApp every day. That is where most of our topics come from: the questions guests actually ask. Pages are published under the team byline. Where a team member agrees to be named, their name and role appear on the page.

How we research

  • Official sources first. Visa and entry rules come from Thai immigration and the official TDAC portal; park rules, fees and closures from Thailand's Department of National Parks; weather and marine warnings from the Thai Meteorological Department.
  • Operators' own information. Ferry and flight details come from each operator's current timetable, not from old blog posts.
  • Our own crews and drivers. Pier locations, pickup times, drive times and sea conditions come from people who are there every day.
  • Two sources for anything that matters. When sources disagree, we publish a range with "approx." and a date, or leave the fact out until we can check it locally.

How we verify prices and dates

ContentHow often we review it
Our trip prices, fees and booking pagesEvery month
Events and party dates (next 14 days)Every week, on Monday
Visa, entry and law pagesEvery month, and the same day a rule changes
Main destination guidesEvery 3 months
Ang Thong closure and reopening messagesBefore 1 November and 16 December each year
  • "Updated" stamps. Every page shows the month it was last changed. We change that date only when the content changes, not for small edits.
  • "Last verified" dates. Fact boxes with prices, fees, timetables or phone numbers show when we last checked them.
  • Prices carry the year. Every price is in THB with the year, for example "1,450 THB (2026)", because prices on the islands change every season.
  • Unconfirmed facts stay off the page. If we can't confirm a price, time or rule, we leave it out rather than guess.

What we sell, and how we keep guides honest

We are a tour business: we sell boat trips, private boats and party transfers, and our guides link to them. We think you should know that. To keep the guides useful whether or not you book with us:

  • We name the downsides. Monsoon swell on the east coast from October to December, the annual Ang Thong closure from 1 November to 15 December, traffic in Chaweng, jet-ski and taxi scams, box jellyfish and road accidents are all on the page where they matter.
  • No paid placements. No business can pay to be listed, ranked or described on this site. Restaurants, beaches and sights are chosen on merit.
  • No links to other operators. We don't link to other tour operators or booking sites. Where naming a ferry company, airline or hospital helps you, we name it in plain text.
  • Official and useful links only. Outbound links go to official Thai government pages, maps, weather and sea forecasts, WhatsApp and our own sister sites.
  • Real reviews only. Reviews on trip pages come only from guests who booked. We don't write, buy or edit reviews, and we don't invent quotes or testimonials.

AI and tools

We use software tools, including AI writing assistants, to help draft and structure pages and to check spelling and consistency. No page is published on the strength of a tool alone: every fact is checked against the sources described above, and the team reviews and approves each page before it goes live. Tools never write reviews, invent experiences or make up prices.

Corrections

If you find a mistake, send the page link and the problem to us on WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 or to the email address on our Contact page. We check the point against a primary source. If you're right, we correct the page and update its date, and for important changes, such as a visa rule or a closure, we add a short "Updated" note at the top of the page saying what changed.

Photo policy and credits

  • Our own photos first. We use photos taken by our team and crews on our own trips wherever we can.
  • Licensed stock second. Where we use stock photos, they are licensed for this use, and credited where the licence requires.
  • Partner photos with permission. We use photos from a partner only with their written permission.
  • No watermarks, no stolen images, no public figures. Every photo shows the actual place or trip it illustrates, and has descriptive alt text.
  • Removal requests. If you believe a photo on this site is yours and was used without permission, contact us and we remove it while we check.
